player_prompt.intro:
Keddi Player {player_id} iqeddar tawalt n Pig Dice.

Tawal:
- Di tawalt-ik, qeddar '[roll]' neɣ '[hold]'
- Roll 2-6: Rnu ɣer tawalt-ik
- Roll 1: Tnaqqas tawalt-ik d uɣul tawalt
- Hold: Rnu tawalt-ik ɣer score-ik d uɣul tawalt
- Amenzu i {winning_score} imḍanen iqeddar

Mi tawalt-ik, ad tinid scores akudan d tawalt-ik.
Ssken-d '[roll]' akken ad tekked di neɣ '[hold]' akken ad tesɛeddi imḍanen-ik.
